summary: Iteration 5 — email alerts, QR tiles, Ecosystem strip. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (added hero.subheading 'insure' check, sections.ecosystem=true check, newsletter idempotency, lead POST timing). Backend logs confirm every POST /api/leads triggers 'Lead alert email sent to hello@amass.africa (id=...)' with 202 Accepted from integrations.emergentagent.com; POST /api/leads latency ~160–350ms (not blocked by email). Frontend: all 17 requested data-testids render and are visible on desktop 1366px (hero/mobile-app/final QR + badges + icons, ecosystem section + 3 cards + hub). Ecosystem heading = 'One platform. Every player. One backend.'. No horizontal overflow at desktop or mobile (375px). QR tiles correctly hidden on mobile (hero-qr/mobile-qr/final-qr all is_visible=False). Hero Play Store badge opens Join Waiting List dialog and submission shows success state.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_API_KEY is injected via platform env (not persisted in /app/backend/.env); test harness now falls back to os.environ. Document this so future testers aren't tripped up.

Lead-alert email send is awaited inside the POST /api/leads request path (adds ~150–300ms). Consider fire-and-forget via BackgroundTasks so slow upstream (Emergent email proxy) never degrades user-facing response time.
No rate-limiting on POST /api/leads — spam vector will directly spam hello@amass.africa. Add basic throttling/captcha before go-live.
PostHog warning in console: 'Events are being dropped because the user agent looks like a bot' — harmless in tests but confirms analytics is live; make sure consent/GDPR copy exists in production.
test_credentials: ADMIN_API_KEY read from process env (platform secret). Not in /app/backend/.env file.
seed_data_creation: A handful of TEST_ leads (fixa_provider, become_agent, contact) + newsletter signups created via pytest run — each triggered one real email to hello@amass.africa. Consider cleaning up via admin API if the inbox gets noisy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADMIN_API_KEY lives only in the process environment (not .env); read it via os.environ.get('ADMIN_API_KEY'). Every POST /api/leads sends a real email to hello@amass.africa via the Emergent email proxy — keep lead tests to a minimum. QR tiles use `hidden md:flex` so they are DOM-present but is_visible()==False on <768px. Ecosystem section testids: ecosystem-section, ecosystem-card-{app|agent|admin}, ecosystem-hub. SearchBar is removed (do not look for search-*). FinalCTA ghost download-btn is removed.
